description:
Retrieve images (charts, graphs, figures, diagrams, photos) and their surrounding
text context from an EPUB or web clip document.

WHEN TO USE THIS TOOL:
- User asks about a chart, graph, figure, diagram, or image in a document
- User wants visual data or illustrations from a book/article
- User references "Figure X.X" or any visual element

Returns each image's base64 data URI, alt text, dimensions, chapter location,
and the paragraph text before/after it so you can describe what the image shows.
Use the optional query parameter to filter images by surrounding text context.

For PDFs, images are embedded in the rendered pages — use highlyt_get_page_text instead.

params.description: Parameters for retrieving images and their surrounding context from EPUB/web documents.

page_end.description: End page number. Defaults to page_start + 4 (max 5 pages per request).

query.description: Optional search query to filter images by surrounding text context (e.g., 'chart revenue growth')

name: highlyt_get_document_images
title: Get Document Images
